name: DiffusionGemma 26B A4B
description: Experimental NVIDIA NVFP4 block-diffusion serving through an isolated vLLM backend on GB10; 256-token canvas, concurrency one, 32K context.
limitations: Uses the vLLM container backend; SparkLab's native autoregressive engine does not implement block diffusion.
The 72 GiB admission reservation is conservative for the measured profile. Throughput evidence is a short warm-prefix probe; quality, long-context, and endurance certification remain outstanding.
Block emission requires end-to-end completion throughput; autoregressive streaming decode tok/s is not comparable.
Default profile enables thinking. Audio is unsupported. Image and tool quality gates have not been run.
